Ten comments

The Stormy Night

This light-hearted jig is another of Tipperary box player Paddy O‘Brien’s compositions. I first came across the tune in Marcus Hernon and Johnny Connolly’s duet album “Seoda na n-Oileán,” where they pair it with yet another of Paddy O’Brien tunes.

The transcription here is based on the version Mickey Dunne plays in this clip: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N_FlXlA4BQM Let me know if you spot any big mistakes.

↳ Posted by slainte on March 22nd, 2015.
